title: Understanding Agentic AI Design Patterns: Building Goal-Oriented, Tool-Using Autonomous Agents
description: Agentic AI design patterns enable autonomous AI agents to plan, reason, and act over time using memory, tools, and self-reflection. These patterns go beyond simple prompt-response interactions by introducing goal-driven, tool-using, and multi-step behavior. They form the foundation for building powerful AI co-pilots, assistants, and autonomous systems.

title: Agentic AI Design Patterns: The Blueprint for Building Autonomous, Tool-Using AI Agents
description: Explore key design patterns in Agentic AI, including ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Multi-Agent Collaboration, and more. Learn how these patterns enable autonomous agents to reason, plan, act, and collaborate effectively across tools and tasks.
